ship_decision: shipped weights are read from fa_config.fit.weights and scored here verbatim (LIVE_WEIGHTS). The mix comparison below is computed on the identical forward chain, so it can never drift from what ships. The shipped mix is kept player-discriminative on purpose: a behavior-dominated composite is nearly player-INDEPENDENT and put one club atop every pitcher's fit list (the measured Giants/Dodgers failure pattern). Need is the only player-specific signal, and the 2026-07-30 fits-v4 pass re-weighted toward it after the concentration tripwire below measured the failure directly. Differences among the top mixes are within noise and are disclosed as such.
notes: REDUCED-FEATURE ANALOG: the live engine's contracted-roster need/window inputs are not reconstructable historically — this gate validates the composite's reduced twin (payroll/tax Y-1, prior wins, behavior <Y, outgoing-FA need proxy, park Y-1)
deal-size context (NPV) is identical across all 30 candidate clubs per signing — conditions the ranking, cannot leak the winner
incumbency (re-signing gravity) is real and ex-ante but absent from the live composite — fitted_full shows its ceiling
mystery-team realism: top-5 is the headline metric; top-1 on 30 clubs is genuinely hard

CONCENTRATION TRIPWIRE (registered 2026-07-30): MRR/top-k are blind to a fit vector that ranks the SAME club first for everyone - a model can score well on signing prediction while being useless as a product. The concentration block measures that directly on the served class.
